detail: Full summary: src/conditions/twining-default.ts:86-92 and twining-full.ts:81-90 snapshot v1-only store paths (.twining/blackboard.jsonl, .twining/decisions/index.json). Under the twining-mcp@2.6.0 pin a fresh benchmark working dir resolves to the sqlite backend, which mirrors to .twining/records/decisions/*.json and never creates those v1 files — so every future run's coordination-artifacts.json will be empty for Twining. Left unfixed; the new snapshot step reads both layouts and is unaffected.
